cases.key: qualify_columns::SELECT * FROM ((SELECT 1 AS foo, 2 AS bar) FULL OUTER UNION ALL BY NAME (SELECT 3 AS bar, 4 AS baz))
cases.reason: ASTRA-014/G3: Resolver rejects parenthesized SELECT operands of a set operation as Unknown set operation. Pre-existing production defect exposed by enabling BigQuery coverage; docs/corpus-coverage.md.

cases.key: qualify_columns::SELECT aa FROM x, UNNEST(a) AS aa
cases.reason: ASTRA-014/G1: BigQuery scalar UNNEST alias is treated as a relation alias, producing aa.aa instead of aa; part of ASTRA-008.

cases.key: qualify_columns::select * from unnest ([1, 2]) as x with offset
cases.reason: ASTRA-014/G1: BigQuery UNNEST star expansion loses the value column x and emits only x.offset; part of ASTRA-008.

cases.key: qualify_columns::select * from unnest ([1, 2]) as x with offset as y
cases.reason: ASTRA-014/G1: BigQuery UNNEST star expansion loses the value column x and emits only x.y; part of ASTRA-008.

cases.key: qualify_columns::select x, a, x.a from unnest([STRUCT(1 AS a)]) as x CROSS JOIN m
cases.reason: ASTRA-014/G1: BigQuery struct-array UNNEST alias binds to m.x and qualifies bare field a; part of ASTRA-008.

cases.key: qualify_columns::WITH cte AS (SELECT [STRUCT(1 AS a)] AS x) select a, x, m.a from cte, UNNEST(x) AS m CROSS JOIN n
cases.reason: ASTRA-014/G1: BigQuery UNNEST field qualification differs, m.a instead of bare a. Canonical-output mismatch, not independently claimed invalid SQL; part of ASTRA-008.

cases.key: qualify_columns::WITH cte AS (SELECT 1 AS col) SELECT * FROM cte LEFT JOIN UNNEST((SELECT ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT x) AS agg FROM UNNEST([1]) AS x WHERE col = 1))
cases.reason: ASTRA-014/G1: BigQuery UNNEST incorrectly binds correlated col to x.col instead of cte.col and emits x.x; part of ASTRA-008.

cases.key: qualify_columns::SELECT * FROM UNNEST(ARRAY<STRUCT<percentile STRING, value INT64, score FLOAT64>>[("p10", 1, 0.0)])
cases.reason: ASTRA-014/G1: BigQuery UNNEST adds synthetic _0 alias and field qualifiers absent from the oracle. Canonical-output mismatch; part of ASTRA-008.

cases.key: qualify_columns::WITH scores AS (SELECT * FROM UNNEST((SELECT ARRAY<STRUCT<percentile STRING, value INT64, score FLOAT64>>[("p10", 1, 0.0)]))) SELECT percentile FROM scores
cases.reason: ASTRA-014/G1: BigQuery UNNEST adds synthetic _0 alias and field qualifiers inside the CTE. Canonical-output mismatch; part of ASTRA-008.

cases.key: qualify_tables::SELECT results FROM Coordinates, coordinates.position AS results
